text:
[document | by Priya Raman | on 2026-01-05 | titled Engineering onboarding]
Wrenfield builds Palisade, a data residency gateway, and Palisade Edge, a lightweight regional proxy. The gateway is TypeScript on Node, the policy compiler is Rust, the control plane is TypeScript and the export worker is Go. We publish a TypeScript SDK and a Go SDK. Issue tracking is Linear under the PAL project. Code review needs one approval, and two for anything touching the policy compiler.
